name: claim-verify-wsc
zh: 把 agent 的完成声明拿去对本机真值核验：端口/路径/进程/git/时钟/算式/引文共 19 个只读原语，三分类判定（supported/contradicted/insufficient），弃权优先。零模型调用、不联网、不写业务文件。含写后即刻核验、部署与重启判据、回执与认账修订、覆盖率三把尺子（声明/任务/完备性下界）。装完重启宿主才生效。
en: Verify an agent's completion claims against real local ground truth: 19 read-only primitives (ports, paths, processes, git, clock, math, citations), three-way verdicts with explicit abstention. No model calls, no network, no writes. Includes post-write inline checks, deploy/reload verdicts, receipts and acknowledgment revisions, and three coverage metrics.
